rows.label: Take control of target / leave in drone
Steer view
rows.binding: Mouse movement

rows.label: Free look
rows.binding: Hold right mouse button

rows.label: Zoom camera
rows.binding: Mouse wheel

rows.label: Show cursor (mouse leaves flight)
rows.binding: Hold {ReleasePointer}; keyboard flight still works

rows.label: Turn the camera with the cursor shown
rows.binding: Hold {ReleasePointer}, then right drag over space (press {ReleasePointer} first)

rows.label: Halt: cancel the current order, or the jump being prepared
Plot a jump (ship you fly) / order one (other ships)
rows.binding: Right click a point in the command view, or a sector on the map, then pick the jump row

rows.label: Start a plotted jump
rows.binding: Aim the ship along the course, then press {Boost}

rows.label: Close the course menu
rows.binding: Escape, or click elsewhere

rows.label: Target under reticle
rows.binding: Middle mouse button

rows.label: Cursor
rows.binding: Always shown; the mouse works in the world except over panels and buttons

rows.label: Select / box select
rows.binding: Left mouse button / left drag; Shift or Ctrl adds

rows.label: Select all owned ships
rows.binding: Ctrl + A

rows.label: Move selection / rotate view
rows.binding: Right click / right drag

rows.label: Pan / zoom
rows.binding: Strafe + Yaw and Forward + Pitch axes; middle drag / mouse wheel

rows.label: Raise / lower plane
rows.binding: Roll axis; Shift + left drag

rows.label: Focus fleet ship
rows.binding: Double-click fleet row

rows.label: Reset the map's panels to their default places
Move the units list, map index or layers bar
rows.binding: Left drag its title; the place is kept for next time

rows.label: Select ship / box select
rows.binding: Left mouse button on a ship / left drag; Shift or Ctrl adds

rows.label: Sector card: preview / pin / close
rows.binding: Hover a sector / left click it / left click outside the galaxy or Escape

rows.label: Pan / zoom
rows.binding: Middle drag / mouse wheel; Strafe + Yaw and Forward + Pitch axes

rows.label: Move or jump course menu
rows.binding: Right click sector

rows.label: Centre on own ship and its layer
rows.binding: Space

rows.label: Scan the sector you are in (again to cancel)
Scan from the galaxy map
rows.binding: Pin the card of the sector you are in, then press its Scan button

rows.label: Asteroid scanner: scan the targeted asteroid
Gas scanner: sample the gas cloud you are in or beside
Asteroid locator: pulse to class the asteroids around you
Module buttons
rows.binding: The chips over the console (hold {ReleasePointer} in flight to click), and Scan on the target panel; only for modules the ship flown has

rows.label: Module cooldown
rows.binding: The three modules share one cooldown and take one request at a time

rows.label: New ship / edit the drone (in the escape drone)
rows.binding: {ToggleEditor} opens New ship; with Ctrl held it edits the drone

rows.label: Place part
rows.binding: Left click on a block face, or drag a part card onto the ship

rows.label: Size the part to place
rows.binding: Hold S over a face, left drag a highlighted ghost face (opposite face stays); click again to place, Esc puts back

rows.label: Turn the part to place
rows.binding: R over a face, then drag a ring round (90-degree steps), or wheel or click it (Shift + click back); click the ghost to place it, R keeps the turn, Esc puts it back

rows.label: Select block / add or remove one
rows.binding: Middle click / Shift + middle click (left click too once right click stops placing)

rows.label: Move the selection
rows.binding: Left drag a selected block onto a face; Esc or right click drops it unchanged

rows.label: Copy / paste the selection
rows.binding: Ctrl + C / Ctrl + V, then click a face

rows.label: Focus the camera on the selection (or the whole ship)
rows.binding: {Follow}

rows.label: Orbit / pan / zoom the camera
rows.binding: Right drag (also while sizing or turning the part) / middle drag / mouse wheel

rows.label: Undo / redo
rows.binding: Ctrl + Z / Ctrl + Y or Ctrl + Shift + Z

rows.label: Delete the selection
rows.binding: Delete

rows.label: Cancel the edit
rows.binding: {EditorLeave}

rows.label: Send chat line / close chat
rows.binding: Enter in the chat field / Escape

rows.label: Quick buttons (players, party, chat)
rows.binding: Click; in the pilot view hold {ReleasePointer} first

rows.label: Interface mode: free pointer, show every window not pinned
Gas window: clouds you have sampled
Leave interface mode
rows.binding: {ToggleInterface} again, or Escape; pinned windows stay on screen

rows.label: Pin a window
rows.binding: The pin in its title bar; a pinned window stays over the view after interface mode ends (hold {ReleasePointer} to click it)

rows.label: Tips
rows.binding: Next / Close buttons; drag the title bar to move a tip; Escape closes the newest
